financing.q: What payment methods do you accept?
financing.a: We accept all major credit cards, debit cards, and Shop Pay. With Shop Pay, you can pay in 4 interest-free installments on purchases over $1,500.

financing.q: How does Shop Pay installment payment work?
financing.a: Shop Pay Installments lets you split your purchase into 4 equal monthly payments. Qualified buyers pay 0% interest with no hidden fees, and approval takes less than a minute at checkout.

financing.q: Do I need a Shop Pay account?
financing.a: No account needed. Shop Pay is available at checkout for eligible purchases. You can pay with any major credit or debit card.

financing.q: Is there interest or hidden fees?
financing.a: No. Shop Pay installments are 100% interest-free for qualified buyers with no hidden fees. What you see at checkout is exactly what you pay.

financing.q: Is Shop Pay financing available on all products?
financing.a: Shop Pay installments are available on most products $1,500 and above. Check your product page or at checkout to see if your item qualifies.

financing.q: Can I pay early with no penalty?
financing.a: Yes. You can pay off your installments early at any time without penalty or additional fees.

walkIn.q: Do you offer custom walk-in humidor installations nationwide?
walkIn.a: Yes. We design and install custom walk-in humidors across the United States — for private residences, cigar lounges, restaurants, and retail spaces. Every project begins with a complimentary consultation, and our team manages design, build, and installation wherever you are.

walkIn.q: How long does a bespoke walk-in humidor installation take?
walkIn.a: Project timelines vary based on scope and complexity. Residential installations typically take 4–8 weeks from design sign-off to completion. Commercial builds may range from 8–16 weeks. Our team provides a detailed schedule during the consultation phase.

walkIn.q: What size room do I need for a walk-in humidor?
walkIn.a: Walk-in humidors can be built in spaces as small as a large closet (approximately 4×6 ft) or as grand as a full dedicated room. We assess your available space and design accordingly to maximise storage capacity and climate efficiency.

walkIn.q: Do you handle the full installation or just consultation?
walkIn.a: We offer end-to-end project management — from initial design and material procurement through to full installation and commissioning. You receive a single point of contact throughout the entire process.

walkIn.q: What are the ongoing maintenance requirements?
walkIn.a: Properly designed walk-in humidors require minimal maintenance. We provide a handover guide covering humidity system upkeep, cedar care, and seasonal calibration checks. Optional remote monitoring packages are available for hands-off management.

walkIn.q: Can you work with an existing room or space?
walkIn.a: Absolutely. The majority of our projects involve converting existing rooms, closets, or custom-built additions. Our design team evaluates insulation, existing HVAC, and structural factors before recommending the optimal approach.
